node.statement: Using positivity and finiteness of K_1,K_2,K_3,K_call,r_reset and of e_env,e_1,e_s2,e_cross,e_sim,e_full, every one of e_env,e_1/K_1,e_s2/K_2,e_cross/K_3,r_reset/K_call,e_sim/K_call,e_full/K_call,[2*max{1,c0_cb*K_call}]^{-1} is positive, finite, universal and independent of dimension, amplification, block data, class count, and stage index. Hence their finite minimum epsilon_MAIN is so as well and has exactly the asserted formula.
